prompt:
S#3. 복도 → 계단 → 상가 — 브이로그 추격 · 17~24초
아이가 캠코더를 쥔 채 격렬하게 뛰는 1인칭 화면. 화면이 마구 흔들리고 기울어지며 벽과 바닥, 천장이 정신없이 스친다. 숨소리와 발소리가 가깝게 들린다. 복도엔 평범하고 친근한 동네 이웃들. 빨래를 널던 아주머니, 계단에 앉은 아이들, 상가 앞 할아버지. 아무 낌새도 없는 따뜻한 일상이다.
주인공 콩아아! 으악, 죄송합니다아~!
계단을 뛰어 내려가면 반짝이는 상가 간판들. 멀리 정문 쪽으로 달려가는 콩이의 뒷모습을 카메라가 겨우 따라간다.
형 (O.S., 멀리서) 야! 거기 서!
S#4. 1층 정문 — 영화 연출 · 24~37초
화면 전환: 캠코더 프레임이 사라지고 영화 화면으로. 주인공이 캠코더를 손에 쥔 채 정문 앞에 멈춰 선다. 콩이가 쇠사슬 감긴 유리 정문 앞에 앉아 있다. 문은 손가락 한 마디만큼 벌어져 있다.
주인공이 문틈에 얼굴을 바짝 댄다.
(주인공 POV) 틈 너머로 눈부신 햇살과 끝없는 꽃밭. 그 빛 속에서 누나가 웃으며 주인공을 내려다본다.
누나 야, 너 여기서 뭐 하고 있어? 같이 놀자. 나와.
주인공 …응.
(주인공 POV) 화면 아래에서 주인공의 작은 손이 프레임 안으로 들어와 문틈 사이로 뻗는다. 누나의 손이 천천히 다가온다. 손끝이 닿기 직전,
S#5. 같은 곳 — 낚아챔 · 37~43초
(주인공 POV 그대로) 화면이 뒤로 확 낚아채진다. 시야가 휙 돌아가며 흔들린다.
형 (O.S., 다급하게 소리치며) 야…!! 뭐 해!! 빨리 가자!!
바닥에 떨어진 캠코더. 빨간 녹화 불이 아직 깜빡인다. 옆으로 누운 화면엔 두 사람의 발만 보인다. 형의 운동화가 다급한 스텝으로 주인공을 끌고 가려 하고, 주인공의 작은 발은 버티듯 멈칫거리며 문 쪽으로 돌아선다.
주인공 (O.S.) 근데… 누나가….
형의 발이 잠깐 멈춘다. 그리고 더 단호하게 주인공을 이끈다. 작은 발이 끝까지 문 쪽을 향한 채 마지못해 끌려간다. 형의 손이 화면 안으로 들어와 캠코더를 집어 든다. 삐빅, 녹화 종료. 암전.
S#6. 302호, 밤 — 재생 (현실) · 43~53초
촛불 하나 켜진 어두운 거실. 잠든 주인공 곁에서 형이 캠코더 액정을 연다. 지지직, 재생. 카메라가 형의 손에 들린 작은 액정 화면 쪽으로 서서히 줌인한다.
컷은 캠코더 화면과 형의 얼굴을 번갈아 보여준다. 영상 전체가 아니라 결정적인 장면만 짧게 끊어서 보여준다.
• 캠코더 화면: 같은 셀카 구도. 하지만 잿빛 폐허가 된 거실, 쓰레기 더미 속에서 아무도 없는 의자에 대고 웃으며 말하는 주인공.
• 형의 얼굴: 굳은 표정. 액정 스피커에서 주인공의 신난 목소리가 흘러나온다. "우리 누나는… 지금 잠깐 나갔나 봐요!"
• 캠코더 화면: 텅 빈 폐허 복도를 혼자 달리는 1인칭 화면. 이웃은 한 명도 없다.
• 형의 얼굴: 눈을 질끈 감는다. 소리로만 "콩아아! 죄송합니다아~!"
• 캠코더 화면 (반전 이미지): 바닥에 떨어진 캠코더가 찍은 정문. 주인공은 유리문 쪽을 향해 선 채, 아까 누나와 나눈 대화를 혼자 중얼거린다. "응… 같이 놀자. 나 갈게." 대답하는 목소리는 녹음되어 있지 않다. 유리문 너머에선 괴물들이 쿵… 쿵… 몸을 처박고, 유리엔 핏자국 같은 얼룩이 번져 있다. 문틈으로 들어와 있는 건 누나의 손이 아니라 괴물의 손이다.
형이 액정을 탁 닫는다. 그리고 박스테이프로 덕지덕지 막아 둔 창문의 틈새로 잠깐 밖을 내다본다. (1~2초)

environment.overview: A present-day Korean neighborhood setting combines modest concrete-and-glass architecture, worn plaster, metal, fabric, and vegetation in pale-gray highlights, domestic middle grays, and deep charcoal shadows.
environment.location_type: Apartment building with ground-floor shops, indoor common passage and entrance, an outdoor threshold view, and a private indoor living room.

zones.name: Public descent
zones.description: A short residential gallery corridor opens directly onto an open stairwell descending into a ground-floor shopping passage; plaster walls, laundry rails, concrete steps, metal handrails, tiled flooring, and illuminated shop signs establish the route. At the corridor mouth, the Laundry neighbor is a broad woman in a light apron hanging sheets; the Stair children are two small children in rounded, mid-gray jackets seated against the stair wall; the Shop grandfather is a stooped man in a dark vest beside a storefront. In the later recorded view, the same recognizable architecture is deserted, with broken sign faces, peeling plaster, and scattered debris.

zones.name: Chained entrance
zones.description: A small tiled vestibule contains tall, metal-framed glass entrance doors, their handles bound together with a heavy chain. One leaf stands open only a finger-joint’s width. The interior side provides standing space beside the doors and an unobstructed floor where the camcorder can fall. The shopping passage is visible through the vestibule’s open interior approach.

zones.name: Beyond the glass
zones.description: Immediately outside the entrance, the child perceives brilliant sunlight and a seemingly endless field of pale flowers, with Sister standing close enough to offer her hand through the opening. The recorded view instead shows a bare exterior landing pressed by Monsters, with dark, bloodlike smears on the glass. These are two presentations of the same view through the doorway, not separate destinations.

zones.name: Room 302
zones.description: A cramped living room contains a low sleeping mattress, an empty wooden chair, accumulated rubbish, damaged plaster, and a window covered with overlapping strips of packing tape that leave one narrow viewing slit. Nighttime darkness obscures much of the decay; one candle stands beside the mattress. The earlier selfie recording exposes the rubbish and empty chair in daylight. No journey into this room is shown.

baseline.lighting: soft daylight in the common passage, with small shop-sign highlights and stronger daylight at the entrance.

breakdown.logline: A child chases Kong through an apparently friendly apartment block and nearly follows a sister’s invitation through a chained entrance, until an older brother intervenes and the recovered camcorder reveals the abandoned building and monsters concealed by the child’s perception.

beats.summary: The child’s frantic pursuit of Kong passes through a neighborhood that appears reassuringly ordinary
Kong stops at a chained entrance, bringing the pursuit to an abrupt halt
The child sees a welcoming sister beyond the narrow opening and reaches toward her
The brother pulls the child away before contact and retrieves the still-recording camcorder
Nighttime playback reveals the child addressing an empty chair in a ruined room
The brother’s expression hardens as the child’s cheerful recorded explanation continues
Playback reveals that the supposedly populated passage was empty
The brother closes his eyes against the sound of the child greeting nonexistent neighbors
The fallen-camera recording exposes monsters at the entrance and a monstrous hand in the opening
The brother shuts the recording away and checks the barricaded window

subjects.name: Child
subjects.appearance: short, slight build; light-gray hooded sweatshirt with the hood down, dark knee-length shorts, pale ankle socks, small dark sneakers
signature_features: oversized rounded hood and narrow bare lower legs create a recognizable silhouette from any direction.

subjects.name: Brother
subjects.appearance: tall, lean build; charcoal zip jacket, medium-gray trousers, bulky pale sneakers
signature_features: markedly longer limbs than Child and oversized pale footwear remain identifiable from front, side, or rear.

subjects.name: Kong
subjects.appearance: compact, low body; pale coat, dark triangular ears, tightly curled tail
signature_features: short-legged proportions and a high curled tail identify the dog from any angle.

subjects.name: Camcorder
subjects.appearance: light-gray rectangular body, dark side strap, hinged rectangular LCD, small red recording indicator
signature_features: the offset flip-out screen and thick hand strap give it an asymmetric silhouette from any angle.

subjects.name: Sister
subjects.kind: Apparition of an older teenage girl
subjects.appearance: slender, taller than Child; pale knee-length dress, dark shoulder-length hair, bare forearms
signature_features: a broad triangular skirt silhouette beneath a compact head of hair remains recognizable without seeing her face; her expression is warmly inviting.

subjects.name: Monsters
subjects.appearance: gaunt charcoal bodies, disproportionately long forearms, angular shoulders, irregular skin surfaces
signature_features: severely hunched torsos and arms hanging below the knees distinguish them from any direction; their hands have elongated, crooked fingers.

spec.camera_move: handheld forward movement with abrupt rolls and downward jolts
spec.backdrop: The corridor’s laundry sheets and plaster wall give way along the visible descent to concrete steps, seated children, metal railings, and bright shop signs above the grandfather.

Child’s close breathing and footfalls accompany “Kooong! Aah, I’m sooorry~!” Brother calls from far behind, “Hey! Stop right there!” Minimal recording brackets and a small recording symbol identify this as camcorder footage.
spec.emotion: Breathless excitement within an apparently safe, familiar world.
spec.transition: Hard cut to a stable cinematic image; the recording overlay disappears.
